st.t: Speak to Tomas Lawry outside the Port Piscarilius bank.
Speak to the poor looking woman in the house just south of the bridge in Port Piscarilius.
Speak to Robert O'Reilly in the house just west of the bridge, south of Tomas Lawry, and give him the bowl of stew.
Enter the Warrens through the manhole a short walk east of Robert O'Reilly's house, marked by the dungeon icon on the minimap.
From the bottom of the manhole, go a little south, then west over the two small bridges to the large island. Speak to Devan Rutter near the fish stall.
Murder Conrad King on the dock on the south side of the Piscarilius Foodhall, the largest building, east of the manhole.
Tell Devan Rutter about the murder.
Enter the tent just north of Devan Rutter and talk to the Queen of Thieves.
Go to Kingstown and head east to the council members' houses. Councillor Hughes' home is the house immediately north, south of the rare trees icon on the minimap. Go up the stairs inside.
Speak to Tomas Lawry in Port Piscarilius.
Talk to Lady Shauna Piscarilius, the Queen of Thieves, in the tent north of Devan Rutter.
